cim_eredeti: Today we're introducing the Perplexity Monitor API.
szoveg_eredeti:
Today we're introducing the Perplexity Monitor API.

Monitor API tracks new developments across the web or changes to specific pages on a schedule, then sends relevant updates to your application through webhooks.

You can follow funding announcements or watch a pricing page, changelog, or policy page for changes.

Perplexity Decider evaluates new search results and page changes against your monitoring goal, such as changes to enterprise pricing. You can adjust the thresholds that determine which updates are sent.

Create a monitor through the API or API Console with the same API key you use for Search and Agent API. 

Available now at $1 per 1,000 runs or URLs fetched.

Read more: https://lnkd.in/ggVwU2CT
